text:
alex: Heads-up — canary strict-schema rollout is spiking fncall rejects in eu-west. Seeing a ~6x increase in \"schema_mismatch\" errors and a lot of requests getting routed to the degen fallback. Sample log: `{"req_id":"abc123","error":"schema_mismatch","field":"tools[0].output"}`. Any quick mitigation?

infra-bot: Alert: structured_validation_reject rate +600% vs baseline for route `/chat.generate` in eu-west. Canary tag: strict-validate-2026-03.

maria: Oof. We're missing per-reject reason labels in metrics — dashboard just shows *validation* bucket. Need `reject_reason` + `schema_path` + an example payload to triage.

alex: Short-term idea: add a routing policy that prefers a permissive variant (soft-validate) when the reject rate for a route > 3% for 1m, TTL 5m. That keeps traffic healthy while we triage. Who owns that policy? product or infra?

sanjay: infra should own runtime routing, product owns canary criteria. I can wire a flag in the gateway. Pseudocode: ```if (route.reject_rate > 0.03) { route.to = model_variants['soft-validate']; route.meta.annotate('fallback','validation'); }```

jo: Heads-up — routing to soft-validate will change semantics and possibly token billing (different model variant). We need audit logs marking fallback and a console toggle so customers can opt-in/out or be warned. Also need to ensure SLA alerts aren't fired during fallback.

maria: Also propose sampling 1% of fallbacked requests + all rejects to an eval queue (store original prompt + model output + parse error). Add telemetry fields: `reject_reason`, `schema_path`, `parser_error`, `example_output`. That will let us triage quickly.

alex: Agreed. High-level plan: (1) add per-reject labels to telemetry (maria) (2) implement short-circuit routing rule with canary flag + kill-switch (sanjay) (3) console: show \"validation fallthrough\" on route details and provide a toggle/notes (product) (4) sample payloads to eval queue for offline triage (maria). Rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% after 24h observation.

jo: +1. Also we need billing attribution: mark tokens consumed during fallback vs original route and ensure invoicing/reporting separates them. I'll coordinate with finance.

sanjay: I'll own the gateway change. Plan: implement `route_on_reject` feature flag, create canary config, add kill-switch and emit `fallback_annotation` to logs. ETA: EOD tomorrow for a dry-run.

maria: I'll update telemetry pipeline to include new fields and add a small dashboard tab with example failing payloads (redact PII). ETA: 48h.

alex: I'll draft a short one-pager for PM/legal/CS explaining customer-visible behavior + suggested user communication. Creating a temporary incident channel for noise.

infra-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-7065432100-validation-spike

jo: One more ask — add a console-level opt-out for \"automatic validation fallback\" per-tenant. We shouldn't silently change behavior for customers with strict compliance needs.

sanjay: Yep — will add tenant-level override and surface it in route metadata.

maria: For long-term we should add a "validation test suite" in the console so teams can preview how strict/soft schemas behave against their prompts before enabling strict canaries. Filing a follow-up RFC.

alex: Nice. Thanks all — I'll post status updates in the incident channel and link the canary config once ready.
